integrity: All algebraic and probabilistic claims have explicit assumptions and a complete mathematical derivation; finite checks are independent consistency tests, not infinite proof or external certification.
limitations: The unique optimizer is for asymptotic leaf variance per path vertex at fixed positive spoke weight. No finite-size global uniqueness or uniform-in-weight fluctuation theorem is claimed; historical priority awaits independent literature assessment.
title: A unique variance-optimal spoke weight for leaves of random fan spanning trees
